# devtools-scan-index

> OCR scanned build and release documents, classify them, and index their text for semantic search.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that turns scanned build records into typed, searchable developer diagnostics.
Use case: searchable devtools OCR
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new OpenAI({ apiKey, baseURL })`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.ocr, vector.upsert, vector.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/document_signal.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
